newsitem.title: INDONESIA: New Zealand to increase trade with Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand to increase trade with Indonesia.

text.p: New Zealand Foreign Affairs and Trade Minister Don McKinnon said his country would increase trade with Indonesia.

"We in New Zealand certainly consider Indonesia as not only an important trading partner but one which will continue to grow for many years to come," McKinnon told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
"I am pleased to say that trade between Indonesia and New Zealand is growing faster than with any other country we have trade with," he said.
"We can only see that continuing to advance," he said.
"Our two-way trade is increasing by 10-12 percent per year, and has been doing so for some time," he said.
Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas said McKinnon discussed mainly trade issues in his meeting with Suharto but gave no details.
